ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: From the above food web diagram, what would happen if all the krills were removed from the web?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web there is an oval labeled “Krill”, located in the upper middle area. A green arrow points from “Krill” to “Blue Whale”, indicating that blue whales feed on krill. Reasoning: The question asks what would happen if all the krill were removed from the food web. According to food web rules, when a certain food source disappears, the consumers that depend on it will decrease because of lack of food. Therefore the number of blue whales will decrease.
